cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Acknowledge Our History
cards.instruction: Make someone recognize that the relationship, memory, or sacrifice mattered and cannot be treated as incidental.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll sort the holiday box. Our ferry ticket goes in the keep pile; we worked too much overtime for that weekend to disappear.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We missed the ferry. I hate being reminded.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the ticket needn't be on top. I'll pack it away. But we stayed together instead of going home for a refund; that choice belongs in the box.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Keep the hotel receipt instead. That part was lovely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Receipt it is. I'll get an envelope; you write 'that part was lovely' on it, however you like. We'll keep your version. I need it in your handwriting so this isn't just my campaign to make the weekend count.

reason: Have A manage the archive while yielding the object and wording to preserve B participation in acknowledging the shared choice.
